title: The Truthful Voice of Ancient Times
intro: There is a soul in the Quran whose story is told in just a few verses, yet their noble qualities shine through with brilliant clarity. Praised by the Almighty for a special virtue, this ancient servant of the Most Merciful holds a place in the pages of revelation. Your task is to identify this remarkable figure. Can you guess who they are?
clues: I am a prophet of Allah who lived among the early generations of humanity.
Allah mentioned me in His Book with other prophets, all praised for the same noble virtue.
I am described as a man of truth in the Quran.
Allah raised me to a high station that few others have attained.
My name is mentioned in Surah Al-Anbiya, grouped with two other prophets praised for their patience.
I am Idris, the truthful and elevated prophet.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Idris
Prophet Nuh
Prophet Ibrahim
Prophet Musa
Prophet Ismail

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Maintaining patience and truthfulness, then elevated to a high station
Building a great ark to save the believers from a devastating flood
Being cast into a blazing fire and emerging completely unharmed
Confronting a mighty king and defeating his army of magicians
Surviving inside the belly of a great fish in the depths of the sea
trial.answer: Maintaining patience and truthfulness, then elevated to a high station

location.label: Key Element
options: A high and exalted station by Allah
A massive ship built from planks and pitched with tar
A raging fire fueled by the idolaters of a wicked king
A vast sea that split into dry paths
The dark belly of a great whale at the bottom of the ocean
location.answer: A high and exalted station by Allah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Admitted into Allah's mercy as one of the righteous
Saved along with all the believers from a worldwide flood
Walked out of the flames untouched by the fire
Led the Children of Israel safely to freedom across the sea
Reunited with their beloved family after long years of hardship
outcome.answer: Admitted into Allah's mercy as one of the righteous

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
